0022600122.text: The Mavericks (1-2, on a one-game losing streak and 2 games back in the Southwest) visit the Miami Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 2 games back in the Southeast) for Dallas's fourth game of the season, with Dallas 1-1 on the road and Miami 0-2 at home. Dallas is missing Caleb Martin, Cooper Flagg, Dereck Lively II, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic, and Flagg, who is averaging 23.0 points in 24.9 minutes per game this season, is among the absences, while Miami has no listed absences. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their last meeting was in Dallas on December 3, 2025, a 118-108 Mavericks win; the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
